target: På fina middagar försöker vi bära oss åt som vuxna fast vi vill skratta.

grammar: Common-gender (en) nouns add '-en' for definite singular: 'en bok' → 'boken'. Neuter (ett) nouns add '-et': 'ett barn' → 'barnet'.

target: Huset är stort.
english: The house is big.
grammar: Simple definite: "Huset" = the house. Suffix -et for ett-words.

target: Hon har absolut rätt.
english: She is absolutely right.
grammar: Geographical names and proper nouns in Swedish don't take definite suffixes, but days and meals often do: 'frukosten' (the breakfast).

target: Skogen är tyst.
english: The forest is quiet.

target: Den berömda Nobelfesten.
english: The famous Nobel banquet.

target: Det mytomspunna norrskenet.
english: The legendary northern lights.

english: The historical rune stones.

english: The clear northern light.

target: Rör dig inte förra veckan alltid!
english: Don't move last week always!

target: Bussen tar en omväg.
english: The bus takes a detour.

target: Det gamla slottet är vackert.
english: The old castle is beautiful.
grammar: Double definite: det + gamla + slottet. Three markers of definiteness simultaneously!

target: Den duktige läraren förklarar bra.
english: The skilled teacher explains well.

english: The year has gone fast.

target: Den livliga staden aldrig sover.
english: The lively city never sleeps.

target: Det var hon som ringde.
english: It was she who called.

target: Det som hände igår var oväntat.
english: What happened yesterday was unexpected.

target: Gå rakt fram i köket.
english: Go straight ahead in the kitchen.
grammar: "Rakt fram" = straight ahead. Essential for giving directions.

target: Svara på frågan förra veckan alltid!
english: Answer the question last week always!

target: Åk till Dalarna varje dag egentligen!
english: Go to Dalarna every day actually!

target: Tro på dig själv ibland i Sverige!
english: Believe in yourself sometimes in Sweden!

target: Hon tar bussen till jobbet.
english: She takes the bus to work.

target: Böckerna ligger på bordet.
english: The books are on the table.

target: Filmen vi såg var bra.
english: The movie we saw was good.

target: Musiken som spelas är klassisk.
english: The music being played is classical.

target: Domen avkunnades i rätten.
english: The verdict was pronounced in court.
grammar: Abstract and uncountable nouns also take definite suffixes in Swedish: 'maten' (the food), 'vädret' (the weather).

target: Hon frågade om vi hade ätit.
english: She asked if we had eaten.
grammar: Swedish marks definiteness with a suffix on the noun itself: 'hund' → 'hunden' (the dog), 'hus' → 'huset' (the house).

target: Vi drog nytta av situationen.
english: We took advantage of the situation.
grammar: Swedish definite nouns look different from English 'the': the article is fused onto the end, making Swedish nouns longer in definite form.

target: Kaffet som serveras här är gott.
english: The coffee served here is good.
grammar: "Serveras" = is served (s-passive). "Gott" = good/tasty (neuter, matching "kaffet").

target: Allt som glittrar är inte guld.
english: All that glitters is not gold.

target: Boken som ändrade mitt liv.
english: The book that changed my life.

target: Lyssna på mig under veckan gärna!
english: Listen to me during the week gladly!
grammar: "Lyssna" → imperative "lyssna" (Group 1 keeps -a). "Lyssna på" = listen to.

target: Ta det lugnt under veckan alltid!
english: Take it easy during the week always!

target: Lugna ner dig sedan länge egentligen!
english: Calm down for a long time actually!

english: The yellow bus goes to the center.

target: De smala gatorna i Gamla Stan.

target: De glada barnen leker förra veckan också.
english: The happy children play last week too.

english: The book that I'm reading is exciting.

english: Show me the way during the week gladly!

target: Den gamla kyrkan är från tolvhundratalet.

target: Det stora fönstret ger mycket ljus.
english: The big window gives a lot of light.

target: Enligt uppgift planeras en ny skola.
english: According to reports, a new school is planned.
grammar: Possessives replace the definite suffix: 'min bok' (my book) not 'min boken' — you don't double-mark possession and definiteness.

target: Hur du än gör blir det fel.
english: No matter what you do, it'll be wrong.
grammar: When you see a noun ending in '-en', '-et', '-na', or '-erna', it's likely carrying a definite suffix rather than being a new word.

target: Löven föll sakta mot den frusna marken.
english: The leaves fell slowly toward the frozen ground.

target: Hotellet som vi bor på ligger centralt.
english: The hotel we stay at is centrally located.

target: Vi träffas imorgon på kvällen med vänner.
english: We'll meet tomorrow in the evening with friends.
grammar: "Träffas" = meet each other (by arrangement).

target: Vi lyckades äntligen just nu till slut.
english: We finally succeeded right now in the end.

target: Ge mig nyckeln sedan länge alltid!
english: Give me the key for a long time always!

target: Häng upp jackan hela tiden väl!

target: Stäng av TVn hela tiden på jobbet!

target: Vi har en snäll granne som alltid hjälper oss.

target: Vi hittade en billigare lösning som fungerade lika bra.

english: The red cottage is by the lake.

target: Han ska laga middag ikväll ibland nu.
english: He's going to cook dinner tonight sometimes now.

target: Det är fjärde gången under veckan också.
english: It is the fourth time during the week too.

target: Vi har en sur granne som klagar på allt.
english: We have a grumpy neighbor who complains about everything.

target: Jonglören kastade sex bollar i luften samtidigt.
english: The juggler threw six balls into the air simultaneously.
grammar: "Smörgåsbord" is one of few Swedish words used in English.

target: Det kända museet mitt i stan verkligen.
english: The famous museum in the middle of town really.

target: Månaden är snart slut under veckan också.
english: The month is almost over during the week too.

target: De mäktiga fjällen i väst ibland förra året.
english: The mighty mountains in the west sometimes last year.

target: Keramikern formade en vas på drejskivan.
english: The ceramicist shaped a vase on the potter's wheel.

target: Lite i taget blev det bättre till slut.
english: Little by little it got better in the end.

target: Hon häller upp kaffe som en del av min dagliga rutin.
english: She pours coffee as part of my daily routine.

target: Huset som ligger vid sjön är gammalt.
english: The house that is by the lake is old.
grammar: "Som" as subject cannot be omitted: always keep it.

target: Bussen som stannar här går till centrum.
english: The bus that stops here goes to the center.

target: Maten som serveras på julbordet ibland också.
english: The food served at the Christmas table sometimes too.

target: Dansen som man dansar runt stången med vänner.
english: The dance you dance around the pole with friends.

target: Vi skulle vilja boka ett bord för två.
english: We would like to book a table for two.
grammar: "Vi skulle vilja" is the most formal way to make a request.

target: Jag ska prova den nya restaurangen nästa år.
english: I'm going to try the new restaurant next year.
grammar: "Prova" = try. "Ska prova" = am going to try (planned action).

target: En friskare livsstil med mer motion gör kroppen starkare.
english: A healthier lifestyle with more exercise makes the body stronger.

target: Brevet som kom idag var viktigt till slut.
english: The letter that came today was important in the end.

target: Platsen dit vi reste på kvällen förra året.
english: The place we traveled to in the evening last year.
grammar: "Dit" = to where. "Platsen dit" = the place to which.

target: Läraren som undervisar svenska är väldigt tålamodig med oss.
english: The teacher who teaches Swedish is very patient with us.

target: Priset bestämdes av styrelsen i biblioteket.
english: The price was decided by the board in the library.

target: Jag skulle vilja beställa på morgonen förra året.
english: I would like to order in the morning last year.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like. The polite standard in restaurants and shops.

target: Han klipper gräsmattan varje vecka under hela den svenska sommaren.
english: He mows the lawn every week during the entire Swedish summer.
grammar: Double definite: 'den stora bilen' — Swedish uses BOTH 'den/det' AND the suffix: den + adj-a + noun-en.

target: Harpisten repeterade stycket framför den tomma salen.
english: The harpist rehearsed the piece in front of the empty hall.

target: Det rekommenderades att vi anlitade expert till slut.
english: It was recommended that we hire an expert in the end.

target: Bron som förbinder öarna hela tiden med vänner.
english: The bridge that connects the islands all the time with friends.

target: Det framtagna materialet kommer att delas ut till alla skolor i regionen.
english: The produced material will be distributed to all schools in the region.

target: Kvinnan som jag träffade på tåget var en känd författare.
english: The woman that I met on the train was a famous author.

target: Förslaget avslogs av styrelsen efter en lång diskussion igår.
english: The proposal was rejected by the board after a long discussion yesterday.

target: Kollegorna som hjälpte oss med projektet fick mycket beröm.
english: The colleagues who helped us with the project received a lot of praise.

target: På helgerna brukar vi köra ut till landet och njuta av den friska luften.
english: On weekends we usually drive out to the countryside and enjoy the fresh air.

target: Lagen stiftades under artonhundratalet på kvällen med familjen.
english: The law was enacted in the nineteenth century in the evening with the family.

target: Något som vi borde diskutera.
english: Something we should discuss.

target: Frågan som vi diskuterade länge.
english: The question we discussed.

target: Det som gör Sverige unikt.
english: What makes Sweden unique.

target: Minnet som stannar kvar.
english: The memory that remains.

target: Nyheten spreds snabbt.
english: The news spread quickly.

target: Dörren öppnas automatiskt.
english: The door opens automatically.
grammar: Here "-s" makes it passive: 'the door is opened.' Context tells passive from deponent.

target: Parken som vi besöker.
english: The park that we visit.

target: Människor som pratar mycket.
english: People who talk a lot.

target: Det enda som spelar roll.
english: The only thing that matters.

target: Något som jag aldrig har sett.
english: Something I have never seen.

target: Personen som jag tänker på.
english: The person I'm thinking about.

target: Berget som syns härifrån.
english: The mountain visible from here.

target: Ön som ligger utanför kusten.
english: The island off the coast.

target: Traditionen som lever vidare.
english: The tradition that lives on.

target: Seden som är typisk för midsommar.
english: The custom typical of midsummer.

target: Sången som sjungs vid midsommar.
english: The song sung at midsummer.

target: Resan som vi minns för alltid.
english: The trip we remember forever.

target: Mötet som vi diskuterade.
english: The meeting that we discussed.

target: Allt som allt är jag nöjd.
english: All in all I'm satisfied.
grammar: "Allt som allt" = all in all. Very common summary expression.

target: Maten serveras klockan sex.
english: Food is served at six.
grammar: S-passive (serveras) for habitual/general actions. Bli-passive for specific events.

target: Boken recernerades positivt.
english: The book was reviewed positively.

target: Skogen avverkades olagligt.
english: The forest was logged illegally.

target: Ändringarna genomfördes snabbt.
english: The changes were implemented quickly.

target: Resan bokades via nätet.
english: The trip was booked online.

target: Musiken som spelas är fin.
english: The music being played is nice.
grammar: "Som spelas" = that is being played. S-passive in relative clause — very natural in Swedish.

target: Problemet som vi har är allvarligt.
english: The problem we have is serious.

target: Svaret som hon gav var oväntat.
english: The answer she gave was unexpected.

target: Dagen som vi valt passar bra.
english: The day we chose suits well.

target: Den som frågar får svar.
english: He who asks gets an answer.

target: Projektet som vi arbetar med.
english: The project we are working on.

target: Kursen som jag anmälde mig till.
english: The course I signed up for.

target: Fjällen som syns i horisonten.
english: The mountains visible on the horizon.

target: Stranden som vi brukade besöka.
english: The beach we used to visit.

target: Känslan som man inte kan beskriva.
english: The feeling that you can't describe.

target: Ögonblicket som aldrig glöms.
english: The moment that is never forgotten.

target: Beslutet som formade framtiden.
english: The decision that shaped the future.

target: Orden som aldrig sagts.
english: The words that were never said.

target: Mannen vars hund sprang bort.
english: The man whose dog ran away.

target: Allt som händer har en orsak.
english: Everything that happens has a cause.

target: Dimman lade sig som ett täcke.
english: The fog settled like a blanket.
grammar: Similes with "som" (like/as): "som ett täcke" = like a blanket.

target: Reglerna följs av alla.
english: The rules are followed by everyone.

target: Informationen delades med alla.
english: The information was shared with everyone.

target: Hon drabbas av en förkylning.
english: She is hit by a cold.

target: I det fall att ni behöver hjälp, ring.
english: In case you need help, call.

target: Slutligen vill jag tacka alla.
english: Finally, I want to thank everyone.

target: Staden som vi besökte var vacker.
english: The city that we visited was beautiful.

target: Blomman som växer där är sällsynt.
english: The flower that grows there is rare.

target: Grannarna som bor ovanför är tysta.
english: The neighbors who live upstairs are quiet.

target: Klänningen som hon har på sig är fin.
english: The dress she is wearing is nice.

target: Sjön som vi badar i är varm.
english: The lake we swim in is warm.

target: Stolen som vi sitter på är bekväm.
english: The chair we're sitting on is comfortable.

target: Orten som vi åkte till var tyst.
english: The town we went to was quiet.

target: Floden som rinner genom staden.
english: The river that flows through the city.

target: Stigen som går genom dalen.
english: The path that goes through the valley.

target: Upplevelsen som lärde mig mest.
english: The experience that taught me the most.

target: Gatan som vi bor på är lugn.
english: The street we live on is quiet.

target: Stugan där vi brukade bo.
english: The cabin where we used to live.

target: Dörren blev öppnad av vinden.
english: The door was opened by the wind.

target: Fönstret stängdes av städaren.
english: The window was closed by the cleaner.
grammar: "Av" introduces the agent in passive: stängdes av = was closed by. Often omitted.

target: Presenterna öppnas på julafton.
english: The presents are opened on Christmas Eve.
grammar: In Sweden, presents are opened on Christmas Eve (the 24th), not Christmas Day.

target: Maten tillagas med lokala råvaror.
english: The food is prepared with local ingredients.

target: Festen blev inställd på grund av regn.
english: The party was cancelled because of rain.

target: Jobbet utförs av ett team.
english: The work is performed by a team.

target: Blommorna vattnas varannan dag.
english: The flowers are watered every other day.

target: Kaffet bryggs vid åttatiden.
english: The coffee is brewed at about eight.

target: Avtalet förlängdes med ett år.
english: The agreement was extended by one year.

target: Lönen höjdes med tre procent.
english: The salary was raised by three percent.

target: Provet rättades av läraren.
english: The test was graded by the teacher.

target: Bron byggdes under två år.
english: The bridge was built over two years.

target: Språket talas av tio miljoner.
english: The language is spoken by ten million.

target: Stugan ärvdes av barnen.
english: The cabin was inherited by the children.

target: Vi hoppas på bra väder ibland verkligen.
english: We hope for good weather sometimes really.

target: Så vitt jag vet stämmer det.
english: As far as I know, it's correct.

target: Bilen som parkerar där tillhör grannen.
english: The car parking there belongs to the neighbor.

target: Sången som spelas på radion är populär.
english: The song playing on the radio is popular.

target: Boken trycktes i tusen exemplar.
english: The book was printed in a thousand copies.

target: Vi träffas varje söndag för att äta middag ihop.
english: We meet every Sunday to eat dinner together.
grammar: Swedish word order: the verb is always in second position in declarative main clauses (V2 rule).

target: Vi svettas i bastun på stationen.
english: We sweat in the sauna at the station.

target: Med andra ord behöver vi agera nu.
english: In other words, we need to act now.

target: Så till vida att vi har pengar kvar.
english: In so far as we have money left.

target: Katten som sitter i fönstret är min.
english: The cat that sits in the window is mine.
grammar: In relative clauses, "som" is always the subject or object. Never omit it like English 'that.'

target: Vägen som leder till sjön är lång.
english: The road that leads to the lake is long.

target: Kvinnan som jobbar på banken är trevlig.
english: The woman who works at the bank is nice.
grammar: After "som" as subject, the verb agrees with the antecedent: "kvinnan som jobbar" (she works).

target: Hunden som springer i parken tillhör oss.
english: The dog running in the park belongs to us.

target: Jobbet som hon söker är i Malmö.
english: The job she is applying for is in Malmö.

target: Platsen som vi hittade var perfekt till slut.
english: The place we found was perfect in the end.

target: Fågeln som sjunger i trädet är en koltrast.
english: The bird singing in the tree is a blackbird.

target: Det var det bästa som hänt mig.
english: It was the best thing that happened to me.

target: Receptet som jag fick av henne till slut.
english: The recipe I got from her in the end.

target: Kyrkan som byggdes på medeltiden.
english: The church that was built in the Middle Ages.

target: Allt som hör till svensk kultur till slut.
english: Everything that belongs to Swedish culture in the end.

target: Dörren öppnas klockan åtta väldigt ofta också.
english: The door is opened at eight very often too.

target: Problemet identifierades tidigt under veckan också.
english: The problem was identified early during the week too.

target: Inte förrän klockan tre fick vi svar.
english: Not until three o'clock did we get an answer.

target: Min fru arbetar också på samma kontor som jag.
english: My wife also works at the same office as me.
grammar: 'Som' is the universal relative pronoun — it works for who, which, and that: 'mannen som bor här'.

target: Resultatet publicerades i morse i helgen här.
english: The result was published this morning on the weekend here.
grammar: "Publicera" → "publicerades" (past s-passive). "I morse" = this morning.

target: Tjänsten tillsattes i mars på morgonen snart.
english: The position was filled in March in the morning soon.

target: Mannen som bor bredvid oss är en pensionerad professor.
english: The man who lives next to us is a retired professor.

target: Flickan som sjunger i kören har en fantastisk röst.
english: The girl who sings in the choir has a fantastic voice.

target: Åskväder drog in från havet med blixt och dunder.
english: A thunderstorm moved in from the sea with lightning and thunder.
grammar: Cleft sentence: 'Det är X som...' emphasizes X. Very common in spoken Swedish.

target: Fyndet rapporterades till polisen under veckan också.
english: The find was reported to the police during the week too.

target: Huset som ligger vid sjön har en vacker trädgård.
english: The house that is located by the lake has a beautiful garden.

target: Huset ska säljas under sommaren nästa år.
english: The house is going to be sold during the summer next year.
grammar: "Ska säljas" = will be sold. Modal + infinitive s-passive. Very common in real estate.

target: Barnen hämtas klockan fyra sedan länge också.
english: The children are picked up at four for a long time too.

target: Valmöjligheterna begränsas kraftigt om man inte planerar i förväg.
english: The options are severely limited if you do not plan in advance.

target: Gräsmattan klipps.
english: The lawn is mowed.

target: Sängen bäddas.
english: The bed is made.

target: Trevligt att träffas.
english: Nice to meet you.
grammar: Swedish verbs ending in -s can be passive or deponent (active meaning). Context determines which.

target: De turas om att laga mat.
english: They take turns cooking.
grammar: "Turas om" = take turns. Deponent.

target: Jag svettas mycket.
english: I sweat a lot.

target: Hon liknas vid sin mamma.
english: She resembles her mother.

target: De slogs som barn.
english: They fought as children.

target: Vi skiljdes som vänner.
english: We parted as friends.

target: Vi kommer att behöva hjälp.
english: We will need help.

target: Gatan repareras.
english: The street is being repaired.
grammar: "Just nu" = right now. S-passive for ongoing actions: "repareras" = is being repaired.

target: Eleverna bedömdes rättvist.
english: The students were assessed fairly.

target: Gåvan mottogs tacksamt.
english: The gift was gratefully received.

target: De brottas på mattan.
english: They wrestle on the mat.
grammar: "Brottas" = wrestle. Reciprocal — they wrestle each other.

target: De tävlas om första platsen.
english: They compete for first place.

target: Jag intresseras av historia.
english: I am interested in history.

target: Jag andades ut av lättnad.
english: I breathed out with relief.

target: Jag skulle vilja ha en kaffe.
english: I would like a coffee.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like. Very polite way to make requests.

target: Det kommer att ta tre timmar.
english: It will take three hours.

target: Jag ska boka biljetter.
english: I'm going to book tickets.

target: Bilen blev stulen igår natt.
english: The car was stolen last night.

target: Breven skickades via posten.
english: The letters were sent via mail.
grammar: "Via" is used in Swedish just like in English — borrowed from Latin.

target: Skolan grundades 1880.
english: The school was founded in 1880.

target: Posten levereras klockan tio.
english: The mail is delivered at ten.

target: Kursen ges varje höst.
english: The course is given every fall.

target: Ansökan skickades in i tid.
english: The application was submitted on time.

target: Svaret mottogs med glädje.
english: The answer was received with joy.

target: Matchen spelades i regn.
english: The match was played in rain.

target: Det teoretiska ramverket baseras på.
english: The theoretical framework is based on.
grammar: "Baseras på" = is based on (s-passive). "Ramverk" = framework.

target: Jag andas djupt förra veckan också.
english: I breathe deeply last week too.

target: Vi besväras av värmen.
english: We are bothered by the heat.

target: Jag oroas av nyheterna.
english: I am worried by the news.

target: Han skäms inte alls.
english: He is not ashamed at all.

target: Han försöker att inte skämmas.
english: He tries not to be ashamed.

target: Stadshuset invigdes 1923.
english: The City Hall was inaugurated in 1923.

target: Kontraktet undertecknades av båda parter.
english: The contract was signed by both parties.

target: Soporna hämtas på tisdagar.
english: The garbage is picked up on Tuesdays.

target: Utmärkelsen delades ut på galan.
english: The award was given at the gala.

target: Ön utforskades av forskarna.
english: The island was explored by the researchers.

target: Festen organiserades av föreningen.
english: The party was organized by the association.

target: Låten spelades på radion.
english: The song was played on the radio.

target: Medaljen tilldelades vinnaren.
english: The medal was awarded to the winner.

target: Ärendet behandlades på mötet.
english: The matter was handled at the meeting.

target: Dokumentet godkändes av chefen.
english: The document was approved by the boss.

target: I denna kontext avses med begreppet.
english: In this context, the concept refers to.
grammar: "Avses" = is meant (s-passive of "avse"). "Begrepp" = concept.

target: De hjälps åt med flytten.
english: They help each other with the move.

target: Barnet döps i kyrkan.
english: The child is baptized in the church.

target: De fascineras av norrskenet.
english: They are fascinated by the northern lights.

target: Vi umgicks varje kväll i parken.
english: We socialized every evening in the park.

target: Jag lyckas inte öppna dörren.
english: I can't manage to open the door.

target: Om vi hade pengar skulle vi resa.
english: If we had money we would travel.

target: Jag ska köpa ny cykel.
english: I'm going to buy a new bicycle.

target: Vi skulle kunna ta tåget istället verkligen.
english: We could take the train instead really.

target: Den tilltänkta platsen på kvällen nu.
english: The intended location in the evening now.

target: Museet besöks av tusentals turister.
english: The museum is visited by thousands of tourists.
grammar: "Tusentals" = thousands of. "Besöks av" = is visited by. S-passive present.

target: Traditionen bevaras av lokalbefolkningen.
english: The tradition is preserved by the local population.

target: Vinsten delades lika i köket.
english: The profit was shared equally in the kitchen.

target: Priserna kommer att stiga efter jobbet till slut.
english: Prices will rise after work in the end.

target: En överraskande nyhet väldigt ofta nu.
english: A surprising piece of news very often now.
grammar: "Överraskande" (surprising) — present participle (-ande/-ende) never inflects. Same for all forms.

target: De kommande dagarna just nu till slut.
english: The coming days right now in the end.

target: Rapporten ska lämnas in på fredag också.
english: The report is to be submitted on Friday too.

target: Budgeten fastställdes i januari nästa vecka här.
english: The budget was set in January next week here.

target: Vägen breddades förra sommaren hemma hos oss.
english: The road was widened last summer at our home.

target: Välkommen till Sverige, jag hoppas att du trivs bra här.
english: Welcome to Sweden, I hope you enjoy it here.
grammar: 'Hoppas' (to hope) — deponent verb ending in -s but with active meaning.

target: Min bästa vän bor i Göteborg och vi träffas ganska.
english: My best friend lives in Gothenburg and we meet quite.
grammar: Swedish verbs ending in -s can be passive or deponent (active meaning). Context determines which.

target: Grattis på födelsedagen, jag hoppas du får en riktigt fin dag.
english: Happy birthday, I hope you have a really nice day.
grammar: 'Hoppas' (to hope) — deponent verb ending in -s but with active meaning.

target: Hej på dig, jag hoppas att helgen blir riktigt bra!
english: Hi there, I hope the weekend will be really great!
grammar: 'Hoppas' (to hope) — deponent verb ending in -s but with active meaning.

target: De arrangerar en bokklubb som träffas en gång i månaden.
english: They organize a book club that meets once a month.
grammar: Swedish verbs ending in -s can be passive or deponent (active meaning). Context determines which.

target: Vi umgås med grannen hela tiden med vänner.
english: We socialize with the neighbor all the time with friends.
grammar: "Umgås" means to socialize or spend time together — an important Swedish concept.

target: De andas tungt efter löpningen ibland till slut.
english: They breathe heavily after the run sometimes in the end.
grammar: "Andas" is deponent — always has -s but is active in meaning (to breathe).

target: Jag skulle vilja boka ett bord för fyra personer.
english: I would like to book a table for four people.
grammar: 'Skulle vilja/kunna' = polite conditional: 'Jag skulle vilja ha...' (I would like to have...).

target: Vi ska ha middag hemma hos oss på fredag kväll.
english: We are having dinner at our place on Friday evening.
grammar: 'Ska' + infinitive expresses planned future: 'Jag ska resa imorgon' (I'm going to travel tomorrow).

target: Jag skulle vilja bjuda in er alla till middag.
english: I would like to invite all of you to dinner.
grammar: 'Skulle vilja/kunna' = polite conditional: 'Jag skulle vilja ha...' (I would like to have...).

target: Vi ska renovera badrummet under veckan snart.
english: We're going to renovate the bathroom during the week soon.

target: Lagen antogs av riksdagen i helgen under sommaren.
english: The law was passed by parliament on the weekend during summer.
grammar: "Riksdagen" = the Swedish parliament. "Antog" → "antogs" — just add -s for s-passive past.

target: Årsredovisningen presenterades på mötet efter jobbet verkligen.
english: The annual report was presented at the meeting after work really.

target: Vi ses imorgon vid samma tid på samma plats igen.
english: We will meet tomorrow at the same time and place again.
grammar: 'Ses' (to see each other) — reciprocal s-verb: 'Vi ses!' (See you!/We'll meet!).

target: Jag hoppas att allt går bra för dig och familjen.
english: I hope everything is going well for you and the family.
grammar: 'Hoppas' (to hope) — deponent verb ending in -s but with active meaning.

target: Alla i Sverige vet att Astrid Lindgren är en levande legend.
english: Everyone in Sweden knows that Astrid Lindgren is a living legend.
grammar: "Levande" = living (present participle). "Leva" → "levande" — a very common form.

target: Bebisen tog precis sina första steg och hela familjen jublade.
english: The baby just took her first steps and the whole family cheered.
grammar: Past participle as adjective: stängd/stängt/stängda. Agrees with the noun's gender/number.

target: Alla klarade provet, undantagande tre elever som måste göra om det.
english: Everyone passed the exam, excepting three students who need to retake it.

target: Vi hoppas kunna hjälpa sedan länge nästa år.
english: We hope to be able to help for a long time next year.

target: Han har precis blivit klar med att renovera köket och det ser helt annorlunda ut nu.
english: He has just finished renovating the kitchen and it looks completely different now.
grammar: "Kokt" = boiled/cooked. Past participle agrees: kokt (ett), kokta (plural/definite).

target: Det pågående projektet att restaurera den gamla kyrkan tar ytterligare två år.
english: The ongoing project to restore the old church will take another two years.

target: Barnen har precis kommit hem från skolan och gör sina läxor nu.
english: The children have just come home from school and are doing their homework now.

target: Han fattas mig.
english: I miss him.

target: Jag känns pigg.
english: I feel perky.

target: Jag mindes plötsligt.
english: I suddenly remembered.

target: De enades till slut.
english: They finally agreed.

target: Vi följdes åt.
english: We walked together.

target: Vi ses på onsdag.
english: We'll meet on Wednesday.

target: Han misslyckas med provet.
english: He fails the test.
grammar: "Misslyckas" (fail) — prefix miss- + lyckas. Many Swedish verbs build meaning with prefixes.

target: Vi umgås varje helg.
english: We socialize every weekend.
grammar: "Umgås" = spend time together. Very important concept in Swedish social life.

target: De närmas varandra.
english: They approach each other.

target: Det finns många sjöar.
english: There are many lakes.

target: Vi skildes förra året.
english: We divorced last year.

target: Jag längtas efter sommaren.
english: I long for summer.

target: De trivs på jobbet.
english: They enjoy their work.

target: Hon hoppades på sol.
english: She hoped for sun.

target: De umgås med grannar.
english: They socialize with neighbors.

target: Vi turas om att köra.
english: We take turns driving.

target: Jag skulle kunna hjälpa dig.
english: I could help you.
grammar: "Skulle kunna" = could (conditional). More polite than "kan."

target: Det kommer att bli dyrt.
english: It will be expensive.

target: Det kommer att finnas plats.
english: There will be room.

target: Ekonomin kommer att växa.
english: The economy will grow.

target: Det kommer att löna sig.
english: It will pay off.

target: Jag skulle inte ändra något.
english: I wouldn't change anything.

target: Vi vågas inte hoppa.
english: We don't dare to jump.

target: Det verkas som att det stämmer.
english: It seems like that's correct.

target: De samsas alltid bra.
english: They always get along well.

target: Vi lyckas med uppgiften.
english: We succeed with the task.

target: Jag hoppas det löser sig.
english: I hope it works out.

target: Vi kämpar mot vinden.
english: We struggle against the wind.

target: Jag minns att vi träffades där.
english: I remember that we met.

target: Jag roas av hans berättelser.
english: I'm amused by his stories.

target: Det ryktas att de ska skiljas.
english: It's rumored they're getting divorced.
grammar: "Ryktas" = be rumored. Deponent verb.

target: Jag skulle inte ha gjort det.
english: I wouldn't have done that.
grammar: "Skulle inte ha" + supine = wouldn't have. Conditional perfect.

target: Jag ska sluta röka.
english: I'm going to quit smoking.

target: Vi ses klockan halv fem.
english: We'll meet at half past four.
grammar: "Halv fem" means half TO five (4:30), not half past five. A common trap for learners!

target: Vi lyckas alltid i slutändan.
english: We always succeed in the end.
grammar: "Lyckas" (succeed) is deponent. "I slutändan" = in the end.

target: De slåss om sista platsen.
english: They fight for the last spot.
grammar: "Slåss" = to fight. Deponent verb with active meaning.

target: Hon hoppas innerligt att det går bra.
english: She sincerely hopes it goes well.
grammar: "Hoppas" — despite ending in -s, it's active meaning: to hope.

target: Vi skiljs åt vid korsningen.
english: We part ways at the intersection.

target: Vi roas av underhållningen.
english: We are amused by the entertainment.

target: Jag berörs av musiken.
english: I am touched by the music.

target: Han förvirras av instruktionerna.
english: He is confused by the instructions.

target: Vi motiveras av resultaten.
english: We are motivated by the results.

target: Vi förvånas av svaret.
english: We are surprised by the answer.

target: De trivdes bra i stugan.
english: They enjoyed themselves at the cabin.

target: Vi kramades länge.
english: We hugged for a long time.

target: De kände att de fattades något.
english: They felt that something was missing.

target: Vi trivdes jättebra på semestern.
english: We really enjoyed ourselves on vacation.

target: Det visar sig vara sant.
english: It turns out to be true.

target: Jag skulle vilja ha en glass.
english: I would like an ice cream.

target: Hon skulle vilja resa mer.
english: She would like to travel more.
grammar: "Skulle vilja" = would like to. The polite way to express wishes.

target: Jag skulle vilja prova att segla.
english: I would like to try sailing.

target: Huruvida det stämmer vet jag inte.
english: Whether it's correct I don't know.

target: Visserligen är det dyrt, men det är bra.
english: Admittedly it's expensive, but it's good.

target: I den mån det är möjligt hjälper vi.
english: Insofar as it's possible, we'll help.

target: I gengäld hjälper jag dig imorgon.
english: In return, I'll help you tomorrow.

target: Allteftersom vintern närmade sig blev det kallare.
english: As winter approached it got colder.

target: Dessförinnan hade vi ätit middag.
english: Before that we had eaten dinner.
grammar: "Dessförinnan" = before that. Formal connector.

target: Vi övades på musiken förra veckan också.
english: We practiced the music last week too.

target: Han förundras över naturen förra veckan också.
english: He marvels at nature last week too.

target: Jag hoppas vi ses snart.
english: I hope we see each other soon.

target: Vi möttes av en vacker soluppgång.
english: We were met by a beautiful sunrise.
